While the countries differ in resources and structure, both illustrate how national policy, culture, & educational priorities shape student opportunities.

Comparative education helps leaders reflect on how systems can better support both teachers and learners.

Great systems don’t happen by accident…they are built through intentional leadership, policy, and investment in educators.

Naghatid ng serbisyo ang programang "Bayanihan sa Barangay" ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) sa piling barangay ng Pasay City ngayong araw.
Pinangunahan ni MMDA General Manager Usec. Nicolas D.Torre III ang aktibidad na naglalayong ilapit ang serbisyo ng ahensiya sa mga komunidad at hikayatin ang bawat mamamayan na makiisa sa gawain.
Nagsagawa ang mga kawani ng MMDA ng drainage declogging, trimming ng mga sanga ng puno, sidewalk clearing operations, at pagpinta ng pavement markings at traffic signage. Nakapag-uwi naman ng grocery items ang mga residente kapalit ng kanilang recyclables sa pamamagitan ng Mobile Materials Recovery Facility ng ahensiya.
Nagsagawa rin ng orientation sessions  upang makapagbigay ng kaalaman tungkol sa solid waste management, anti-smoking, anti-littering, at disaster preparedness.  Mayroon din one-stop shop query service para naman ma-check ng mga motorista kung may violations ang kanilang sasakyan.
Sa kanyang mensahe, hinikayat ni GM Torre ang mga nakibahagi at ipagpatuloy ang nasimulang gawain ng MMDA na nangunguna sa pagpapaunlad ng Metro Manila. Binigyang-diin din niya ang kahalagahan ng kolaborasyon at bayanihan upang masiguro ang kaligtasan at kalinisan ng bawat komunidad.
Nagpahayag naman pasasalamat ang mga kinatawan ng Pasay City government at barangay officials ng Barangay 41, 42, 43, 44, 45, at 46 para sa mga serbisyo ng MMDA sa kanila.
#mmda #bayahihansabarangay

Naghain ng show cause order ang LTO laban sa may-ari at driver ng sasakyang huminto sa kahabaan ng NLEX para bumaba ang pasahero nito upang pulutin ang isang patay na hayop sa daan.

Dahil sa anila'y panganib na idinulot nito sa ibang motorista, iginiit ng LTO na sinuspende nang 90 araw ang lisensiya ng driver, na posibleng maharap sa mga reklamong reckless driving at obstruction of traffic.

(📸: Land Transportation Office - Philippines/Facebook)

Remarks of the Deputy Spokesperson of the Chinese Embassy Guo Wei on Allegations of So-called “Wolf Warrior Diplomacy”

Q: Certain Philippine media accused the Chinese Embassy of engaging in “wolf warrior diplomacy” during the recent public exchanges between the Embassy and some Philippine public officials. What is the comment from the Embassy?

A: Some people seem to enjoy putting labels on others. This time, they chose the title of the movie Wolf Warrior to label Chinese diplomats.

But have they actually watched Wolf Warrior? The film tells a simple story: Chinese personnel, diplomats included, protecting Chinese citizens overseas. A normal storyline. A responsible country protecting its people. Nothing sinister. 

In fact, that is precisely what diplomats are meant to do. When China’s interests and dignity are challenged, we stand firm. When confronted with smears or attacks, we respond, without hesitation: words for words, actions for actions, talk for talk. To be clear, we are not wolves. We are diplomats doing our jobs. Our position is straightforward: China’s national interests and dignity must be safeguarded. At the same time, promoting exchanges and cooperation between China and the Philippines remains our responsibility.

Through sustained efforts, political dialogue between China and the Philippines has resumed after a hiatus of more than a year. Both sides now are implementing the agreed roadmap. Philippine DFA officials recently visited Beijing, completing the second step. Since the introduction of the 14-day visa-free policy, more Chinese tourist come to visit. Direct flights between Fujian and Cebu will resume on March 29. China has donated $1 million in cash and RMB 10 million in emergency supplies for humanitarian aid to the Philippines. The China Coast Guard rescued 17 Filipino seafarers after their cargo ship overturned. And there have been no major incidents in the South China Sea recently. These tangible results did not appear by accident; they reflect sustained, practical efforts. We will continue working to keep bilateral relations stable and moving forward.

At last, the movie Wolf Warrior 2 racked up a box office total of RMB 5.68 billion (about USD 870 million), becoming China’s highest-grossing film at the time and the only non-Hollywood production then ranked among the global all-time box office top 100. 

If you have some free time, perhaps give it a watch. You may find it less dramatic than the label suggests.

Video link: 
https://t.co/mVffrINk1m
